pages.text: The wind blew hard. Laundry fluttered through the alley.
Mom stepped outside. Whoosh! Her hat blew away.
Grandpa Mole, Mrs. Magpie, and Mr. Pig all rushed after the hat too.
The hat bounced down the alley. Mr. Pig lunged at it. Hop! It bounced into the air.
Mrs. Magpie tried to snatch it in the air and bumped into Grandpa.
All three tangled together and tumbled. The hat flew far away.
Coco stood still and watched the laundry. It was all fluttering this way.
Coco spread both arms and waited. The hat came spinning back.
Plop! The hat landed in Coco's arms. Mom took it and pulled it firmly onto her head. Behind them, the three muddy helpers clapped.
